visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white buttoned cardigan and small gold hoop earrings, is seated in a brightly lit indoor room. Behind her is a white brick-textured wall and a yellow cushion on a couch. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy, smiling broadly and pointing her fingers downward toward a laptop while gesturing with her hands. (2) The visual cuts to a close-up screen recording of a MacBook laptop. A Notes application is open, and a line of Chinese text is being typed out character by character in real-time. The woman then appears in a medium shot, holding a smartphone with a clear case covered in various colorful stickers, and she points enthusiastically at the laptop screen again. (3) A detailed screen recording of the macOS System Settings interface follows. The mouse cursor navigates through the 'Accessibility' section, clicks on 'Spoken Content,' and then opens the 'Voices' sub-menu. A long scrolling list of different Chinese voice profiles, including names like 'Dongmei' and 'Tingting' with download icons, is clearly visible. (4) The woman returns to a medium shot, reacting with exaggerated facial expressions of confusion, amusement, and surprise while listening to the audio outputs. She points her index finger at the laptop screen repeatedly to emphasize the digital voices. The video ends with her laughing and covering her mouth as a stylized text overlay with question marks appears at the bottom center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, cheerful female voice speaks Traditional Chinese at a natural, energetic pace. The background music is a light acoustic guitar pop track with a steady, moderate BPM. The signal is extremely clean with minimal noise floor. (2) A sharp digital clicking sound marks the transition to a text-to-speech voice with a heavy Northeastern Chinese regional accent. The BGM continues smoothly, but the primary speaker pauses. The synthesized voice sounds clear but distinctively artificial. (3) A series of UI clicking sounds occurs, followed by a Cantonese-speaking female synthesized voice. The voice mispronounces a string of characters at the end as 'W 阿姨,' triggering the main speaker to interject with a higher-pitched, surprised tone and inquisitive inflection. (4) A final clicking sound precedes a third synthesized Mandarin voice that speaks with professional clarity but is cut off abruptly. The main speaker bursts into a high-valence, energetic laugh. A soft popping sound effect and a light digital stinger close the audio track.
